_doc: Travel network fares (#1226, docs/notes/adventure/fares.md), in Swiss francs, 2nd class, full fare. Rail and bus: the SBB distance tariff on the straight distance x detour. Ships: the lake operators' distance tariff. Cable cars: per line one-way price by RopewayService line key, a default otherwise. Every value marked "verify": true is a plausible figure the team should check against the published tariff and update at the December timetable change.

rail._doc: Degressive francs per tariff kilometre by band (fitted to Zurich-Winterthur 26 km ~ CHF 13.60, Zurich-Bern ~ CHF 56, Geneva-Zurich ~ CHF 91), minimum fare for short hops.

ship._doc: The big lakes' operators (CGN, SGV, BLS, URh, ZSG): dearer per kilometre than the train.

cableCar._doc: One way, full fare. lines: RopewayService line key -> { name, price }.
